d: Jharkhand SIR Row: SIR aur MMDR par charcha ke lie bulae gae jharkhand vidhanasbha ke vishesh satr ke pahle din speshal intensiv rivijan par siyasi sangram dekhne ko mila...jahan sadan men satta paksh ne matdata suchi ke vishesh gahan punrikshan ki prakriya par saval uthae... to bijepi ne sarkar ki mansha par hi saval khare kar die...kisi ne ise matadhikar par hamla bataya... to kisi ne ghuspaithiyon ko bachane ki siyasat...pure din ki bahas ke bad sadan men mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ko pad se hatane ka prastav bhi parit ho gaya...ye riport dekhie...
